optimizer: Adam, FP32 masters/state; gradient clip1; no loss scaling
forward: INT8-quantized operands widened to INT32 for selected CPU integer products/reductions; floating point between integer stages
backward: floating-point straight-through surrogate; no integer gradient arithmetic
weight_scales: GS128 symmetric absmax, refreshed from FP32 masters every forward; scales detached
activation_scales: per-chart training absmax with20% headroom, EMA0.95; initialized first use, frozen in eval
other_float: FP16 geometry outside integer stages; FP32 chart predicates/scales and loss
device: CPU only, not GPU throughput experiment
baseline: previous completed FP16-geometry training reused; no FP16 rerun
